_comment: X-ROM AVF daemon configuration. Installed to /system_ext/etc/xrom/avf.json,
labelled xrom_avfd_config_file, readable only by the xrom_avfd domain.
This file may only make the policy stricter. Every value is clamped to a
compiled-in ceiling by DaemonConfig::Load(), and a missing, oversized or
malformed file falls back to fail-safe defaults rather than being partially
applied. The per-task-class table is deliberately not here: it lives in
IsolationPolicy::DefaultOptions() so that changing it requires a signed image
update instead of an edit to a config file.
_allow_debuggable_vm: Permits DebugLevel.FULL VMs, which expose a guest adb shell and full kernel logs. Requires a userdebug or eng build as well; this flag alone is never sufficient on a user build.
_max_concurrent_vms: Hard ceiling on simultaneously admitted tasks. Ceiling: 4. Fail-safe default: 1.
_memory_budget_mib: Total guest RAM across all running VMs. Ceiling: 4096. Fail-safe default: 512.
_instance_image_bytes: Size of the per-VM instance.img. Must be a multiple of 4096. Ceiling: 536870912. Fail-safe default: 67108864.
_allowed_uids: UIDs permitted to submit tasks at all. uid 0 is rejected here on principle; IsolationPolicy admits it separately on debuggable builds only.
_vm_launch_timeout_ms: How long to wait for microdroid_launcher to start the payload. A Microdroid boot is well under this on supported hardware; exceeding it means the VM is wedged and gets torn down.
_task_timeout_ms: How long a payload may run once ready.
